import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {createRequire} from 'node:module';
import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {checkServerIdentity} from 'node:tls';
// BEGIN FIXED RDS TLS OPTIONS (exercised verbatim by owned-loopback tests).
const RDS_CA_SHA256='b1711d12bae51838581281e23b6cb97b1074016873b4dafc80ed14002462dd77';
const RDS_CA_PEM=Buffer.from('','base64').toString('utf8');
function rdsTlsOptions(connectionString){
  assert.equal(createHash('sha256').update(RDS_CA_PEM).digest('hex'),RDS_CA_SHA256);
  const databaseUrl=new URL(connectionString);
  assert.equal(databaseUrl.protocol,'postgresql:');
  assert.match(databaseUrl.hostname,/^[a-z0-9.-]+\.us-east-1\.rds\.amazonaws\.com$/u);
  assert.equal(databaseUrl.searchParams.get('sslmode'),'require');
  assert.equal(databaseUrl.searchParams.getAll('sslmode').length,1);
  for(const name of databaseUrl.searchParams.keys())assert.ok(['schema','sslmode','connection_limit'].includes(name));
  // pg-connection-string sslmode would replace the explicit ssl object.
  databaseUrl.searchParams.delete('sslmode');
  return {connectionString:databaseUrl.toString(),ssl:{ca:RDS_CA_PEM,rejectUnauthorized:true,
    servername:databaseUrl.hostname,
    checkServerIdentity:(_hostname,certificate)=>checkServerIdentity(databaseUrl.hostname,certificate)}};
}
// END FIXED RDS TLS OPTIONS

const SOURCE='42988dae5fb7bc2fff3af582ca15a0836a4477c5';
const INPUT_SOURCE='a260004e9923ef5bbe7bd8f32bb4cbddd3c7be31';
const ROLE_HASH='4b3814bb3ebcecb8a55b67680a3346b05b2354953e529cae43bb36be2df869c6';
const PREFIX='MERI_MAIL_POSTINDEX_RECEIPT ';
const hash=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');
const TABLES=['mail_messages','mail_threads','engagement_connections'];
const FIELDS=['id','client_id','tenant_id','connection_id','thread_id','removed_at','subject','body_text','from_email','from_name','to_recipients_jsonb','cc_recipients_jsonb','received_at','sent_at','created_by_user_id'];
export function validateInput(input){
 assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(input).sort(),['asOf','kind','sourceSha','tenantId','userId']);
 assert.equal(input.kind,'meri-mail-plan-read');assert.equal(input.sourceSha,INPUT_SOURCE);
 for(const key of ['tenantId','userId'])assert.match(input[key],/^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/u);
 assert.equal(input.asOf,'2026-10-02T16:17:22.000Z');return input;
}
export function redactPlan(node,depth=0){
 assert.ok(node&&typeof node==='object'&&depth<20);const out={};
 for(const key of ['Node Type','Strategy','Join Type','Parent Relationship','Scan Direction'])if(node[key]!==undefined){assert.match(node[key],/^[A-Za-z ]{1,60}$/u);out[key]=node[key];}
 for(const key of ['Startup Cost','Total Cost','Plan Rows','Plan Width'])if(node[key]!==undefined){assert.ok(Number.isFinite(node[key])&&node[key]>=0);out[key]=node[key];}
 for(const key of ['Parallel Aware','Async Capable','Inner Unique'])if(node[key]!==undefined){assert.equal(typeof node[key],'boolean');out[key]=node[key];}
 if(node['Relation Name']!==undefined){assert.ok(TABLES.includes(node['Relation Name']));out['Relation Name']=node['Relation Name'];}
 if(node['Index Name']!==undefined){assert.match(node['Index Name'],/^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,200}$/u);out['Index Name']=node['Index Name'];}
 if(node.Plans){assert.ok(Array.isArray(node.Plans)&&node.Plans.length<=20);out.Plans=node.Plans.map(p=>redactPlan(p,depth+1));}
 return out;
}
export function countSql(schema='public'){
 assert.ok(schema==='public'||/^meri_mail_plan_[a-f0-9]{32}$/u.test(schema));
 return `EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, ANALYZE FALSE, VERBOSE FALSE, COSTS TRUE)
 SELECT count(DISTINCT (m.connection_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.metadata_jsonb->>'internetMessageId', ''), m.id::text)))::int AS n
 FROM "${schema}".mail_messages m
 JOIN "${schema}".engagement_connections c ON c.id=m.connection_id
 JOIN "${schema}".mail_threads t ON t.id=m.thread_id
 WHERE m.tenant_id=$1::uuid AND c.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND t.tenant_id=m.tenant_id
 AND t.connection_id=m.connection_id AND c.created_by_user_id=$2::uuid
 AND c.provider::text IN ('microsoft_365','google_workspace') AND m.removed_at IS NULL
 AND m.created_at<=$3::timestamptz AND (COALESCE(m.received_at,m.sent_at)<=$3::timestamptz OR COALESCE(m.received_at,m.sent_at) IS NULL)
 AND (m.subject ILIKE $4 OR m.body_text ILIKE $4 OR m.from_email::text ILIKE $4 OR m.from_name ILIKE $4 OR m.to_recipients_jsonb::text ILIKE $4 OR m.cc_recipients_jsonb::text ILIKE $4)`;
}
export function assertCoveringIndex(indexes,schema='public'){
 const rows=indexes.filter(r=>r.index_name==='mail_threads_tenant_connection_id_cover_idx');assert.equal(rows.length,1);
 const row=rows[0];assert.equal(row.table_name,'mail_threads');assert.equal(row.method,'btree');assert.equal(row.indisvalid,true);assert.equal(row.indisready,true);assert.equal(row.predicate,null);
 const definition=schema==='public'?row.definition:row.definition.replace(` ON ${schema}.mail_threads `,' ON public.mail_threads ');
 assert.equal(hash(definition),'7097d64ec1650dfa8e004e89a1e2f6f267cb7924e869993bb44fb235e9716c9e');
 return true;
}
export async function inspectMailPlan(client,input,schema='public'){
 validateInput(input);const sql=countSql(schema);
 await client.query('BEGIN READ ONLY');
 try{
  await client.query("SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s'");await client.query("SET LOCAL idle_in_transaction_session_timeout='15s'");
  assert.equal((await client.query('SHOW transaction_read_only')).rows[0].transaction_read_only,'on');
  await client.query("SELECT set_config('app.current_tenant',$1,true)",[input.tenantId]);
  const relations=(await client.query(`SELECT c.relname,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,c.reltuples::float8 AS estimated_rows,c.relpages,
   pg_has_role(current_user,c.relowner,'USAGE') AS owns_relation,r.rolsuper,r.rolbypassrls
   FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname=current_user
   WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND c.relname=ANY($2::text[]) ORDER BY c.relname`,[schema,TABLES])).rows;
  assert.equal(relations.length,3);
  const indexes=(await client.query(`SELECT t.relname AS table_name,i.relname AS index_name,am.amname AS method,x.indisvalid,x.indisready,
   pg_get_indexdef(i.oid) AS definition,pg_get_expr(x.indpred,x.indrelid) AS predicate
   FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid=x.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.relnamespace
   JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid=x.indexrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid=i.relam
   WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND t.relname=ANY($2::text[]) ORDER BY t.relname,i.relname`,[schema,TABLES])).rows;
  assert.ok(indexes.length<=100);assertCoveringIndex(indexes,schema);
  const safeIndexes=indexes.map(({definition,predicate,...row})=>{
   assert.ok(TABLES.includes(row.table_name));assert.match(row.index_name,/^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,200}$/u);assert.match(row.method,/^[a-z]{1,30}$/u);
   return {...row,definitionSha256:hash(definition),predicateSha256:predicate===null?null:hash(predicate),removedOnly:predicate==='(removed_at IS NULL)',trigram:/\b(?:gin|gist)_trgm_ops\b/u.test(definition),fields:FIELDS.filter(f=>new RegExp('\\b'+f+'\\b','u').test(definition))};
  });
  const pattern='%CAPIRO\\_MERI\\_DIAGNOSTIC\\_20261002\\_1616\\_NO\\_MATCH%';
  const result=(await client.query(sql,[input.tenantId,input.userId,input.asOf,pattern])).rows;
  assert.equal(result.length,1);const document=result[0]['QUERY PLAN'];assert.ok(Array.isArray(document)&&document.length===1&&document[0].Plan);
  assert.equal(document[0]['Execution Time'],undefined);
  return {coveringIndexQualified:true,relations,indexes:safeIndexes,plan:redactPlan(document[0].Plan),explainSqlSha256:hash(sql),scopeSha256:hash(JSON.stringify(input)),analyze:false,customerRowsRead:0,conditionsPersisted:false};
 }finally{await client.query('ROLLBACK');}
}
export async function main(){
 let client,stage='INPUT';
 try{
  assert.equal(process.env.GIT_SHA,SOURCE);assert.equal(process.env.RELEASE_SHA,SOURCE);
  const input=validateInput(JSON.parse(process.env.MERI_MAIL_PLAN_INPUT));
  const require=createRequire('/app/apps/api/package.json'),{Client}=require('pg');
  const url=execFileSync(process.execPath,['/app/apps/api/scripts/lib/pe-compose-database-url.js'],{encoding:'utf8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']});
  stage='CONNECT';client=new Client({...rdsTlsOptions(url),application_name:'meri-mail-postindex-readonly',connectionTimeoutMillis:15000,query_timeout:10000});await client.connect();assert.equal(client.connection.stream.authorized,true);
  const identity=(await client.query('SELECT current_user AS role,current_database() AS database,clock_timestamp() AS observed_at')).rows[0];
  assert.equal(hash(identity.role),ROLE_HASH);assert.equal(identity.database,process.env.DB_NAME);
  stage='CATALOG_EXPLAIN';const result=await inspectMailPlan(client,input);
  console.log(PREFIX+JSON.stringify({kind:'meri-mail-plan-readback',schemaVersion:1,status:'READBACK_COMPLETE',readOnly:true,mutations:0,sourceSha:SOURCE,observedAt:identity.observed_at.toISOString(),roleSha256:ROLE_HASH,databaseSha256:hash(identity.database),tlsVerified:true,caBundleSha256:RDS_CA_SHA256,...result}));return 0;
 }catch(error){console.log(PREFIX+JSON.stringify({kind:'meri-mail-plan-readback',schemaVersion:1,status:'READBACK_FAILED',readOnly:true,mutations:0,stage,code:['42501','57014','ETIMEDOUT','ECONNREFUSED','ERR_ASSERTION','UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY','ERR_TLS_CERT_ALTNAME_INVALID'].includes(error?.code)?error.code:'READBACK_REFUSED'}));return 1;}
 finally{await client?.end().catch(()=>{});}
}
if(process.env.MERI_MAIL_PLAN_INPUT!==undefined)process.exitCode=await main();
